rows.text: Crrk crrk — Bridges are vital to a city. Just like how even the greatest ruler still needs a secret escape route, if we become isolated from each other, then the steps of "Death" shall swiftly follow.
rows.speaker: Meridian Nymph

rows.text: That's the beauty of the "Janus's Hidden Passage." The separated will all eventually be connected into one, whether they like it or not...
rows.speaker: Meridian Nymph
